title: libpod: preserve checkpoint log path on failure
body:
Save checkpoint paths before calling the runtime so inspect can report the log after a failed checkpoint. Add regression coverage to the existing TCP checkpoint test.

Related to #25154

Verified the failure before and after the fix with local and remote Podman. The e2e suite compiles, and full PR validation passes in the official validation image. Successful checkpoint/restore could not be verified because of seccomp restrictions in the Docker test environment.

Do you think this is enough for #25154, or should we also look into the original suggestion of returning the log contents or adding a --log option?
